correctness.rationale: The proof uses the exact fair-tie zero-temperature generator, finite energy-monotonic transition graph, 222 orbit-level rational harmonic equations, and boundary values for 10 terminal states. One standalone program reconstructs all rational orbit fractions. A separate standalone checker independently verifies every one of 65,536 full-state harmonic identities over 720,896 allowed directed moves, confirms exactly ten singleton closed communicating classes, and reproduces all six seed-geometry probabilities. No sampled estimate or infinite extrapolation is used.

originality.rationale: The inspected 2001 exact fair-tie zero-temperature process is on infinite Z^2, and the closest 2025 same-graph, same-rule paper presents numerical balanced-initial outcome curves and a general no-blinker theorem but not six exact three-seed rational probabilities or the sharp threshold. A published Q4 synchronous majority table has different updating and tie rules, and a published bipartite Glauber result concerns a different graph without ties. The complete three-seed law is not logically implied by the inspected claims. Exact priority remains provisional because earlier unindexed or unpublished computation may exist.
residual_risks: No exhaustive global historical priority search is possible; unindexed articles, theses or datasets may have these finite exact probabilities.

The full text of the 2001 Spirin–Krapivsky–Redner paper was not inspected; its indexed abstract concerns another graph and supplies no decisive same-object implication.
The finite exact certificate has not been independently assessed by an external mathematical reviewer.

value.rationale: The Boolean four-cube is a canonical degree-four Ising quench network with direct foundational and contemporary literature. The result determines the sharp smallest minority droplet capable of nucleating a frozen nonconsensus state under standard fair-tie dynamics, distinguishes six natural Hamming-distance geometries by exact nontrivial probabilities, and identifies a stable eight-spin half-cube created from only three initial minority spins. The threshold and kinetic geometric selectivity are physically motivated and not consequences of a static trapped-state count or simple parameter substitution.
